ad_library.summary: 3S Solutions is running 6 active Meta ads (5 captured with full copy here), started between 11 September and 19 October 2026. Four different hooks are live: the Rs. 78,000 subsidy + Rs. 10,000 offer, the free site consultation, a Hyderabad customer's Rs. 4,280-to-Rs. 187 bill story, and subsidy-eligibility guidance. The newest clicks land on fb.me links, and the bill-saving creative pushes a savings calculator hosted off-domain at 3scalculator.vercel.app. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.destination: fb.me 'See details'; one creative sends to 3scalculator.vercel.app
funnel.meaning: The newest clicks land inside Facebook or on a calculator hosted on a third-party Vercel domain - not on 3ssol.in. That traffic cannot be retargeted from your own site, the calculator's visitors never see your contact form, and the measurement lives outside your analytics.

findings: The newest ads (19 Oct) drive to fb.me links, and the Rs. 4,280-to-Rs. 187 bill-saving creative pushes a savings calculator at 3scalculator.vercel.app - a third-party host, not 3ssol.in. That is your best hook sending your best prospects to somebody else's domain.

3ssol.in itself is content-rich - on-grid and off-grid system guides, Hyderabad locality pages (Jubilee Hills, Miyapur, Gachibowli, Uppal, LB Nagar, Kukatpally, Ameerpet, Balanagar, Hitec City) and a real contact form - and none of the six ads sends anyone there.
Six ads, four hooks in five weeks: the testing instinct is there, but with the clicks inside Facebook or on a Vercel app there is no first-party data to tell you which hook actually converts.
Contact splits across numbers - the ad promotes 9000121084 and 9581177119, the site footer lists +91 7075441637 (Telangana) and +91 7075441638 (AP), all feeding one inbox, praveen@3ssol.in.
The distributor positioning - Growatt distributor in India, Vikram Solar distributor for AP & TG, TGREDCO-empanelled - is the strongest trust asset on the site and appears in no ad.
next_steps: Move the 60-second savings calculator onto 3ssol.in (or a subdomain you own) with the Meta Pixel installed, so the bill-saving ad's traffic becomes your retargetable audience.
Point every ad at a page you own
Swap the fb.me destinations for dedicated landing pages - one per hook (subsidy offer, free consultation, bill savings) - each with a form and pixel.
Growatt and Vikram distributorships plus TGREDCO empanelment are proof competitors cannot copy in a headline. Put them in the creative.
Publish one Hyderabad number and one AP number across ads, site and forms, and add a second inbox so praveen@3ssol.in is never the single point of failure.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
